assertions.subject: the install generates, imports and removes no certificate
assertions.expected: 0 of the 4 observed stores changes its sorted-thumbprint digest
assertions.note: Digest over the sorted thumbprint set, not a count: a swap of one certificate for another keeps the count and moves the digest.
